name: Budding organoid · 20k cells (3D)
blurb: A hollow organoid: ~20,000 vertex-model cells tiling a sphere as a spherical-Voronoï epithelium. Scattered growth centres drive patches of cells to grow and bulge outward, so the smooth ball buds into a lumpy organoid. Real Rust vertex mechanics keep the cells well-formed. Orbit to inspect it; colour by area to see the buds.
